summary: This note describes Chinatown in Sydney, an urban locality in the southern part of the Sydney central business district in New South Wales, Australia. It sits in Haymarket between Central station and Darling Harbour, within the City of Sydney local government area. The note states it is Australia's largest Chinatown.
one_line: Chinatown is an urban locality in Haymarket, Sydney, between Central station and Darling Harbour, and is Australia's largest Chinatown.
key_facts: Chinatown, Sydney has Chinese names 雪梨華埠 and 悉尼唐人街.
Chinatown, Sydney is an urban locality in the southern part of the Sydney central business district.
Chinatown, Sydney is located in New South Wales, Australia.
Chinatown, Sydney is located in Haymarket.
Chinatown, Sydney is located between Central station and Darling Harbour.
Chinatown, Sydney is part of the local government area of the City of Sydney.
Chinatown, Sydney is described as Australia's largest Chinatown.
